title: review-freeze-fingerprint's trackedIndexDiffSha256 uses abbreviated blob ids, so the fingerprint depends on the environment's abbreviation length
outcome: The freeze fingerprint's tracked-index-diff component hashes a diff with full blob ids (`git diff --cached HEAD --binary --full-index`), so the same staged input yields the same component in every worktree and environment.
acceptance: scripts/review-freeze-fingerprint.mjs (and any compiled counterpart that recomputes it) computes trackedIndexDiffSha256 from a full-index diff; a test shows the component is identical for the same staged input whether core.abbrev or the repository's object count would give different abbreviation lengths.
The schema version or the docs state the change, so earlier manifests aren't silently compared against the new component.
